description: Order-flow TOXICITY (VPIN — Volume-Synchronized Probability of Informed Trading, Easley/Lopez de Prado/O'Hara) for a token: how one-sided/informed is the recent flow? Computed via Bulk Volume Classification over 1-min candles. Returns vpin 0-1 (→1 = heavily one-sided / toxic / informed flow; →0 = balanced) and a label. The academic standard MMs/LPs use to price adverse selection — useful to size quotes, time entries, or detect informed pressure. Solana (base58) or Robinhood-chain (0x). Free 10/day, then $0.01/call.
name: vpin
